table_alignment_basis: Equal top-level source/Word table counts, no nested source tables; ordinal alignment with independent PDF cell-text check

unmatched_cells.source_cell:
Returns are individual debits that have reached the debtor’s agent and have been settled at the inter-bank level, but the debtor’s agent is then unable to make the collection for one of a number of reasons, for example, account closed, no funds, customer dead, etc. 
The debtor has the unconditional right during "n" days after a debit to instruct its bank to revoke the debit. Following that instruction the debtor's account is credited by its bank and the debit is returned electronically through the clearing process to the creditor’s agent.

The creditor agent identifies the original direct debit instruction and generates an offsetting clearing transaction in favor of the debtor. Subject transaction is submitted to the instructed agent for settlement under quotation of the original direct debit reference and the reversal reason.

limitations: Word pagination is additional to stable original paragraph/XML/table locators.
Normalized cell text is independently searched in its Word-PDF span; this does not prove grid/merge/footnote or semantic fidelity.
Repeated identical source assets can produce multiple candidate pages; no occurrence page is selected without further evidence.
Floating/composite objects without unique binary asset hashes require direct page inspection.
Word locale can produce a STYLEREF header error. This is a derived-render artifact, not a statement in the immutable original.
No visual-review or reviewed status is conferred by this helper.
